newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-RAPTORS COACH WALKER FINED $7,500.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-RAPTORS COACH WALKER FINED $7,500.

text.p: Toronto Raptors coach Darrell Walker was fined $7,500 Wednesday for slamming the ball to the court at the end of his club's 105-103 loss to the Indiana Pacers on Monday.
Walker was fined for verbally abusing the referees and failing to leave the court in a timely fashion following his ejection with one-tenth of a second remaining, the NBA said.

The Raptors led 103-102 with 1.8 seconds left when the Pacers inbounded the ball to Reggie Miller, who tried a three-pointer. Toronto guard Doug Christie blocked the shot but was called for a foul, giving Miller three free throws with a tick left on the clock.

Walker, whose team had blown a 19-point halftime lead, stormed onto the court to protest the call. He grabbed the ball away from referee Monty McCutchen and slammed it hard to the floor, drawing a technical foul and an ejection.

"I thought he made a clean block, but the call was made," Walker said after the game. "We knew that Reggie was going to take the last shot and I thought Doug made a clean play. As far as I'm concerned, we won the game."
Miller made the technical foul shot, then sank two of three free throws, giving Indiana a 105-103 win.
Walker's ejection carried an additional $1,000 fine.
